registers.name: MAGIC
registers.semantics: Fixed little-endian ASCII PLSM, 0x4D534C50.

registers.name: ABI_VERSION
registers.semantics: High16 major=1; low16 minor=0; reject unknown major.

registers.name: IMAGE_ID_W0
registers.semantics: Immutable image UUID word; all four checked against manifest.

registers.name: IMAGE_ID_W1
registers.semantics: Immutable image UUID word; all four checked against manifest.

registers.name: IMAGE_ID_W2
registers.semantics: Immutable image UUID word; all four checked against manifest.

registers.name: IMAGE_ID_W3
registers.semantics: Immutable image UUID word; all four checked against manifest.

registers.name: BUILD_ID_W0
registers.semantics: Build identity word; diagnostic, not cryptographic image attestation.

registers.name: BUILD_ID_W1
registers.semantics: Build identity word; diagnostic, not cryptographic image attestation.

registers.name: BUILD_ID_W2
registers.semantics: Build identity word; diagnostic, not cryptographic image attestation.

registers.name: BUILD_ID_W3
registers.semantics: Build identity word; diagnostic, not cryptographic image attestation.

registers.name: CAPABILITIES_LO
registers.semantics: Capabilities bit0 SWD bit1 SPI; any unsupported protocol bit must be 0.

registers.name: CAPABILITIES_HI
registers.semantics: Reserved 0 in v1.

registers.name: SITE_PRESENT_BITMAP
registers.semantics: Bits0..7 actual instantiated Sites; never claim Sites by max capacity.

registers.name: SITE_READY_BITMAP
registers.semantics: Subset of present; readiness alone insufficient to admit jobs.

registers.name: PPU_STATUS
registers.semantics: Bit0 PL_READY; bit1 FAULT; reserved 0. NOT AXI isolation evidence.

registers.name: HW_REVISION
registers.semantics: Board-defined nonzero revision matched to Board Descriptor.

registers.name: PPU_ERROR
registers.semantics: Latched diagnostic code; software may refuse admission.

registers.name: MAP_REVISION
registers.semantics: Value 1, exact map revision.

registers.name: SITE_STRIDE_BYTES
registers.semantics: Value 4096; 4KiB per Site.

registers.name: MAX_TRANSFER_BITS
registers.semantics: 8..8192, multiple of 8; actual FIFO implementation constrained by RTL.

registers.name: RESET_CAUSE
registers.semantics: Diagnostic only; no safe-state guarantee.

registers.name: GLOBAL_STATUS
registers.semantics: Bit0 READY bit1 FAULT; no cross-Site commands.

registers.name: FAULT_SITE_BITMAP
registers.semantics: Bit per faulted Site; indicates error, not isolation.

registers.name: GLOBAL_EVENT
registers.semantics: Event bits0..7 only diagnostic; polling v1; no IRQ needed.

registers.name: BROKER_EPOCH_HINT
registers.semantics: Optional hardware boot epoch hint; 0 denotes unavailable; never authoritative ownership.

registers.name: SITE_ID
registers.semantics: 1..8; must match window index.

registers.name: SITE_ABI_VERSION
registers.semantics: Major1 minor0; checked before writes.

registers.name: SITE_CAPABILITIES
registers.semantics: Subset of image and board capability.

registers.name: SITE_STATUS
registers.semantics: Exactly one IDLE(1), BUSY(2), DONE(4), FAULT(8) bit; FAULT requires explicit recovery.

registers.name: SITE_ERROR
registers.semantics: Latched error enum; no automatic replay.

registers.name: INFLIGHT_SEQ
registers.semantics: Accepted 32-bit sequence ID while BUSY; zero otherwise.

registers.name: RX_WORDS_AVAILABLE
registers.semantics: Count of FIFO words readable; 0..CAPACITY_WORDS.

registers.name: TX_WORDS_FREE
registers.semantics: Count of writeable FIFO words; 0..CAPACITY_WORDS.

registers.name: COMMAND
registers.semantics: 1 SWD_XFER, 2 SWD_LINE_RESET, 3 SPI_TRANSFER; commit last after setup and barrier.

registers.name: SEQUENCE
registers.semantics: Nonzero unique sequence per Site and boot epoch; no reuse while pending.

registers.name: PROTOCOL
registers.semantics: 1 SWD, 2 SPI; must match opcode/capability.

registers.name: FLAGS
registers.semantics: Bit0 SPI_CS_HOLD (SPI only), others 0; default deassert CS at command end.

registers.name: BIT_COUNT
registers.semantics: SWD_XFER=32; SWD_LINE_RESET=50..128; SPI=8..MAX_TRANSFER_BITS and multiple of 8.

registers.name: ARG0
registers.semantics: SWD request bits0 APnDP,1 RnW,2 A2,3 A3; other bits 0; SPI chip select 0..3.

registers.name: WDATA
registers.semantics: SWD write data, or 0 for reads / SPI.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_TICKS
registers.semantics: Hardware bounded budget; implementation-specific tick rate from board descriptor.

registers.name: TX_DATA
registers.semantics: SPI FIFO push: little-endian bytes per 32-bit word, final padding zero.

registers.name: RX_DATA
registers.semantics: SPI FIFO pop; SWD read uses DONE_DATA, not this FIFO.

registers.name: DONE_SEQ
registers.semantics: Completed sequence, must equal submitted SEQUENCE.

registers.name: DONE_STATUS
registers.semantics: Result enum; distinguish transport failure and target ACK.

registers.name: DONE_WORDS
registers.semantics: Number of available result words, bounded by CAPACITY_WORDS.

registers.name: ABORT
registers.semantics: Write 1: request abort for current Site; acknowledgement may fail; not bus-drain evidence.

registers.name: CAPACITY_WORDS
registers.semantics: Actual FIFO depth, 1..256, checked before SPI load.

registers.name: CLOCK_DIV
registers.semantics: Hardware serial clock divider 1..65535, per Site; accepted only when IDLE.

registers.name: DONE_DATA
registers.semantics: SWD 32-bit read payload when DONE_STATUS=OK.

registers.name: ACK_SEQ
registers.semantics: Ack completed DONE_SEQ only after result drained; returns Site to IDLE; no clear-on-read.

registers.name: TRANSACTION_COUNTER
registers.semantics: Wraparound diagnostic completed-command count, never a durable identity.

registers.semantics: Nonzero unique sequence per Site and boot epoch; no reuse while pending.

registers.name: PROTOCOL
registers.semantics: 1 SWD, 2 SPI; must match opcode/capability.

registers.name: FLAGS
registers.semantics: Bit0 SPI_CS_HOLD (SPI only), others 0; default deassert CS at command end.

registers.name: BIT_COUNT
registers.semantics: SWD_XFER=32; SWD_LINE_RESET=50..128; SPI=8..MAX_TRANSFER_BITS and multiple of 8.

registers.name: ARG0
registers.semantics: SWD request bits0 APnDP,1 RnW,2 A2,3 A3; other bits 0; SPI chip select 0..3.

registers.name: WDATA
registers.semantics: SWD write data, or 0 for reads / SPI.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_TICKS
registers.semantics: Hardware bounded budget; implementation-specific tick rate from board descriptor.

registers.name: TX_DATA
registers.semantics: SPI FIFO push: little-endian bytes per 32-bit word, final padding zero.

registers.name: RX_DATA
registers.semantics: SPI FIFO pop; SWD read uses DONE_DATA, not this FIFO.

registers.name: DONE_SEQ
registers.semantics: Completed sequence, must equal submitted SEQUENCE.

registers.name: DONE_STATUS
registers.semantics: Result enum; distinguish transport failure and target ACK.

registers.name: DONE_WORDS
registers.semantics: Number of available result words, bounded by CAPACITY_WORDS.

registers.name: ABORT
registers.semantics: Write 1: request abort for current Site; acknowledgement may fail; not bus-drain evidence.

registers.name: CAPACITY_WORDS
registers.semantics: Actual FIFO depth, 1..256, checked before SPI load.

registers.name: CLOCK_DIV
registers.semantics: Hardware serial clock divider 1..65535, per Site; accepted only when IDLE.

registers.name: DONE_DATA
registers.semantics: SWD 32-bit read payload when DONE_STATUS=OK.

registers.name: ACK_SEQ
registers.semantics: Ack completed DONE_SEQ only after result drained; returns Site to IDLE; no clear-on-read.

registers.name: TRANSACTION_COUNTER
registers.semantics: Wraparound diagnostic completed-command count, never a durable identity.

ordering: Verify image receipt and board resource before any map
Require Site lease, exact batch IC, READY and Idle
Write arguments and bounded payload to FIFO
Issue software/device ordering barrier before COMMAND (HAL/HIL TBD)
Write COMMAND last with nonzero SEQUENCE
Poll bounded DONE_SEQ and STATUS; no unbounded bus wait claim
Write matching ACK_SEQ after successful drain
Release Site lease; fault and require reconciliation on ambiguous result

swd_xfer.argument: ARG0 bits0:3 encode APnDP/RnW/A2/A3; source driver handles request parity
swd_xfer.outcome: SWD acknowledgement and read/write payload; WAIT/FAULT are terminal command responses, no implicit replay

swd_line_reset.output: SWDIO logical high for BIT_COUNT cycles; no per-target power or reset

spi_transfer.tx_rx: Full duplex, little-endian byte packing, length <= MAX_TRANSFER_BITS and FIFO capacity
spi_transfer.cs: ARG0 selects CS0..CS3 only; board wiring subject to independent review
